Sent by Theo at 20:15 - We can now confirm that all power in the area should be back on. Our engineers had to unexpectedly turn off the power to 149 customers in the Halesworth IP19 9 area to safely remove a kite from the overhead cables.

If your power isn't on or there's anything you'd like to talk to us about, call us on 08003163105 which is free from landlines and mobiles.
